questions.question: In an examination hall seven students Aditi, Cindy, Jeanie, Kirti, Niti, Preeti, and Sweety are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order. Cindy sits third to the right of Sweety. Aditi and Preeti are immediate neighbours of Cindy. More than two person sit between Preeti and Sweety. Jeanie is the only neighbour of Niti. Jeanie sits to the right of Aditi. What is the position of Niti with respect to Kirti?
questions.questionHtml:
In an examination hall seven students Aditi, Cindy, Jeanie, Kirti, Niti, Preeti, and Sweety are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order.

Cindy sits third to the right of Sweety. Aditi and Preeti are immediate neighbours of Cindy. More than two person sit between Preeti and Sweety. Jeanie is the only neighbour of Niti. Jeanie sits to the right of Aditi. What is the position of Niti with respect to Kirti?
questions.solution: Here, 'Niti' is Fifth to the right of 'Kriti'

questions.question: Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Only two people sit between P and S. N is the immediate neighbour of S and M. Only one person sits to the right of P. N sits second to the left of O. Y is an immediate neighbour of P. Total how many people sit between P and M?
questions.questionHtml:
Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Only two people sit between P and S. N is the immediate neighbour of S and M. Only one person sits to the right of P. N sits second to the left of O. Y is an immediate neighbour of P.

Total how many people sit between P and M?
questions.solution:
Given : Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. 

Explanation :

1) Only one person sits to the right of P.

2) Only two people sit between P and S.

3) N is the immediate neighbour of S and M.

4) N sits second to the left of O.

5) Y is an immediate neighbour of P.

As position of Y with respect to P is not known yet therefore there are two possible positions for Y.

After positioning Y only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e B.

Thus, according to the final arrangement four people i.e O, S, N and M sit between P and M.

Hence, "Four" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five men M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting in a row facing north. M is sitting at one end and O is on the other end. Q sits to the immediate left of M and to the immediate right of P. Who sits third to the right of O?
questions.questionHtml: Five men M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting in a row facing north. M is sitting at one end and O is on the other end. Q sits to the immediate left of M and to the immediate right of P. Who sits third to the right of O?
questions.solution:
Given: Five men M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting in a row facing north.

1) Q sits to the immediate left of M and to the immediate right of P.

2) M is sitting at one end and O is on the other end.

And, N will sit on the remaining place.

Here, 'Q' sits third to the right of O.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: Seven girls A, L, K, S, F, D, and M are sitting in a straight line, facing North. A sits at the extreme left. M sits exactly between K and S. L sits second to the right of S. M sits second to the left of F. Who sits to the immediate right of A?
questions.questionHtml: Seven girls A, L, K, S, F, D, and M are sitting in a straight line, facing North. A sits at the extreme left. M sits exactly between K and S. L sits second to the right of S. M sits second to the left of F. Who sits to the immediate right of A?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven girls A, L, K, S, F, D, and M are sitting in a straight line, facing North.

A sits at the extreme left.

M sits exactly between K and S.

L sits second to the right of S.

M sits second to the left of F.

So, K sits to the immediate right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting on a bench facing towards north but not necessarily in the same order. P is immediate neighbour of Q, S is immediate neighbour of T. P is not sitting with R who sits on the right end of the bench. P sits to the right of S and T. S sits to the right of T. In which position P is sitting?
questions.questionHtml:
P, Q, R, S and T are sitting on a bench facing towards north but not necessarily in the same order. P is immediate neighbour of Q, S is immediate neighbour of T. P is not sitting with R who sits on the right end of the bench. P sits to the right of S and T. S sits to the right of T.

In which position P is sitting?
questions.solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting on a bench facing towards north but not necessarily in the same order.

1) P is not sitting with R who sits on the right end of the bench.

2) P is immediate neighbour of Q.

3) P sits to the right of S and T.

4) S is immediate neighbour of T and S sits to the right of T.

So, P is sitting at the 'Third from left' place.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
